Whether you‚Äôre going for a run, walk, or play, the ASICS Gel Kinetic Fluent has you covered. Constructed with synthetic leather, fibre, and PU, these shoes feature technical welding and eyelet elements inspired by the archives that offer a breathable fit and durability through every stride. The Scutoid GEL technology provides advanced cushioning for everyday wear, while the FF BLAST PLUS cushioning ensures responsive rebounds and lightweight comfort. Completed with a durable rubber outsole for superior traction, the ASICS Gel Kinetic Fluent boasts a TRUSSTIC support system that delivers improved stability with every step.

  • Strategically designed elements increase impact absorption for added comfort.
  • Contemporary materials add depth and texture.

Long days on your feet call for cushioning you can feel and a look that stands out beyond the gym. The ASICS GEL-Kinetic Fluent blends archive-inspired design with everyday comfort, pairing layered synthetic materials and technical welding details with a smooth, supported ride for walks, casual wear, and light training. Scutoid GEL technology helps absorb impact, FF BLAST PLUS cushioning keeps the feel light and responsive, and the TRUSSTIC support system adds stability through every step.

  • Archive-inspired upper with contemporary materials for breathable depth and texture
  • Scutoid GEL technology and FF BLAST PLUS cushioning help deliver soft comfort and energized rebounds
  • TRUSSTIC support system helps promote stability
  • Durable rubber outsole provides dependable everyday traction

Size & Fit Guidance

For the best fit, we recommend starting with your usual size. Reviewers most often mention a comfortable fit, while shoppers between sizes or those who prefer a little more room through the forefoot may want to compare options.

Best For

Best for everyday wear, walking, and casual workouts when you want all-day comfort with a sport-meets-lifestyle look.

Styling & Versatility

The GEL-Kinetic Fluent combines retro running inspiration with a modern, cushioned feel, making it easy to pair with leggings, joggers, or relaxed denim. Its layered upper and sculpted sole bring a technical edge to everyday outfits.

Break-In & Durability

Reviewers highlight lasting comfort and quality for regular wear, with many saying the shoe feels good from the start. The supportive build and durable outsole make it a reliable choice for repeat wear across daily routines.
